req.title: Update existing post
req.statement: The system shall update the row when POST /<id>/update is called by the post's author with a title and body, and redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should update a post when the correct endpoint is called by the post's author. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful update, a negative test to check unauthorized access, and a boundary test to ensure proper handling of missing title input.

tests.name: test_update_post_success
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by James
actions: Call POST /1/update with new title and body
expected: Post with id 1 is updated with new title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})
response = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_update_post_unauthorized
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by James
actions: Call POST /1/update with new title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
response = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Unauthorized Update', 'body': 'Should not update'})
assert response.status_code == 403

tests.name: test_update_post_missing_title
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by James
actions: Call POST /1/update with empty title and valid body
expected: Response contains 'Title is required.' error message
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})
response = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': '', 'body': 'Valid Body'})
assert b'Title is required.' in response.data
